text:
The themes in the text revolve around the dual interpretation of Mary Shelley's *Frankenstein*, highlighting how a reader's background shapes their understanding of the narrative. For readers with scientific or ethical training, the story serves as a critique of scientific hubris and an exploration of the moral obligations inherent in creation. Conversely, readers with religious perspectives may view the narrative as a warning against the transgression of divine boundaries, specifically the act of "playing God." This divergence illustrates that the text functions simultaneously as a commentary on scientific responsibility and a theological cautionary tale, depending on the lens through which it is read.

The tool used for writing is a Large Language Model (LLM).
